highlights.reason_zh: 从订阅演示变成有价格和限制的可调用 API，直接改变是否能验证。
highlights.reason_en: A priced, callable API replaces a subscriber demo and directly changes testability.

highlights.reason_zh: 生产规模与人工抽查给出 coding agent 调查流水线的真实边界。
highlights.reason_en: Production scale and manual review expose real boundaries for a coding-agent investigation pipeline.

highlights.reason_zh: 高噪声应急场景的真实部署说明模型分流与人工确认如何配合。
highlights.reason_en: A noisy emergency deployment shows how model triage and human confirmation can work together.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开产物扩展到三种 harness，同时 held-out 结果限制了泛化判断。
highlights.reason_en: Public artifacts expand to three harnesses while held-out results limit generalization claims.

highlights.reason_zh: 首日交易把超大规模定价从预期转成公开市场信号。
highlights.reason_en: First-day trading turns unusually large pricing from expectation into a public-market signal.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 36/36 成功，并主动覆盖模型、开发工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、中文材料、小团队与重大综合新闻。部分页面只有日期精度；厂商与合作方指标尚待独立验证；本轮未选入重大综合新闻例外。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded, with active coverage of models, developer tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, Chinese-language material, small teams and exceptional general news. Some pages exposed dates only; publisher and partner metrics await independent validation; no exceptional general-news item was included.
